publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.2.0 pins rer 0.2.20 package mode. A hosted installation needs no private runner for public website checks or alerts: the Cloudflare Worker runs public HTTP and keyword checks every minute and sends email, signed JSON webhook and Slack notifications itself, with the same one-attempt, never-resent custody as a runner, and the runner contact indicator now reflects only a private runner's own requests. Each scheduled run stays within the Workers Free plan's 50 outbound requests: checks that do not fit wait for the next minute instead of failing, and a check cut short by the budget is Unknown, never a target failure. A hostname that does not resolve (NXDOMAIN or no address) is now a failed check with that cause, so it opens an incident, for hosted checks and private runners alike. A monitor of the app's own address is refused at save with a pointer to a private runner. It also adds a one-time heartbeat key with its curl command in the console, an incident history panel and API, a signed-in access-denied page for members, per-environment deploy secrets, and rer signin for owner access without email (additive migration 0037_owner_signin). Browser flows are no longer part of the documented feature set. Upgrading from 0.1.3 applies only migration 0037 and keeps monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings; rer deploy now also takes MAIL_PROVIDER and MAIL_API_KEY. Hosted Worker checks validate DNS answers but rely on Cloudflare's outbound network rather than a pinned connection. Local and hosted evidence does not establish recipient acceptance.
